headline: Unitree Technology announces issue price of 150.8 yuan per share: P/E ratio of 219.23 times is above the industry average, corresponding to total market value over 60 billion yuan
summary: Unitree Technology announced an issue price of 150.8 yuan per share, with a P/E ratio of 219.23 times, above the industry average. The implied total market value exceeds 60 billion yuan.
why: Unitree is a Chinese maker of quadruped and humanoid robots, and its listing is a test of investor appetite for robotics and AI-related hardware companies.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: 宇树科技公告发行价格为 150.8 元 / 股：市盈率 219.23 倍高于行业平均，对应总市值超 600 亿元
